en-US.description: A GUI music downloader for Apple Music, Bandcamp, Deezer, Qobuz, Spotify, Tidal, and More
en-US.longDescription: An easy to use music downloader written in Python. OnTheSpot has support for various music services and, unlike similar projects, downloaded files and metadata are sourced directly from the service of your choosing. The app includes a GUI, CLI, and Web UI frontend. To get started download the app here or run the command below.
en-US.name: OnTheSpot
